rollback_evidence: G60: the IOS VLAN database is read with show vlan brief separately from running-config (in VTP server mode a normal-range VLAN lives only in vlan.dat; an extended-range VLAN also appears as a vlan stanza in running-config). Only unused active Ethernet VLANs may be created, renamed or deleted. The config archive does not reliably return VLANs; this table uses the existing compensating inverse and recover path, with independent check-account readback. There is no device timer for this table; loss of Admin/management requires recover. Measured on IOSvL2 15.2(20200924:215240) (switch image only; a router image is refused).
